definition: A non-linear function applied to a neuron's output that allows neural networks to model complex, non-linear relationships.
details: Without activation functions, stacking layers would collapse into a single linear transformation. Common examples include ReLU, GELU, sigmoid, and tanh.
story: Think of an orchestra warming up: no single instrument carries the piece, but together they make the sound. At the bottom of every machine is a design — the shape of it, and how its pieces talk to each other. The layout decides what the machine can even attempt, before it learns a single thing. The shape of the machine is half the idea. That blueprint is Activation Function.
